name: mnemos
description: Your memory and skills for Claude, stored on this computer, one context at a time.
long_description: Runs Mnemos in local mode: notes in SQLite under your Mnemos folder, no Docker, no account. Each install of this extension serves one context (e.g. personal); other contexts are not visible to it.

home.title: Mnemos folder
home.description: Where your notes and skills live (created if empty).

context.title: Context
context.description: Which context Claude uses here (e.g. personal, work).
